title: 首个真实动物候选：六格熊猫
goal: Produce one original, visually convincing panda candidate with logical occupied_cells 123457 for a small genuine animal-puzzle vertical slice, to be reviewed by the human before integration.

asset_request.abstraction_brief: Panda may recline, tuck limbs, roll, curl or use playful exaggerated proportions. NO naturalistic projection or species-to-shape restriction. Preserve panda readability/cuteness and expressive silhouette rather than obeying realistic anatomy.
asset_request.pose_view_brief: ART chooses camera angle and visual orientation, no fixed global viewpoint. Candidate first. Do not copy reference game's dogs, character poses or art.
asset_request.silhouette_brief: 3x3 bounding grid with occupied numbers 1 2 3 / 4 5 empty / 7 empty empty. Occupied cells are logic, not physical ground footprints. Main silhouette should make active cells intuitively readable, without treating every pixel of a cell as mandatory fill. Avoid large mass in inactive cells (row2 col3, row3 col2/3); small appendage overhangs are reviewable. All four rotations visually reviewed.
asset_request.source_rights: Original asset creation only; no third-party/game screenshot tracing, no protected character imitation; log tool/model/version and provenance

budget_limit.stop_rule: After two materially different tries or time budget, report best candidate or BLOCKED. No heavy custom processing pipeline.

in_scope: Generate or create a single original panda visual candidate in warm animation-film-style 2D static CG with nuanced fur, clear silhouette, clean Alpha
Make at most two candidate iterations within budget; if transparency cannot be achieved report honest blocker and evidence rather than fake PNG
Include a grid-alignment review image for the exact six occupied cells, plus a transparent original sprite when achievable
Review visual identification, pose cuteness, 4-way rotated appearance and obvious mass intrusions on inactive cells
Keep specific visual versioning, source/provenance and actual file/hash if bytes transfer can be independently verified
Present human-facing candidate(s) with version ID, issues, cost, and exact evidence; ask HUMAN for formal G3 visual decision
out_of_scope: More than one species or one final panda pose unless expressly approved
Generation of the other two placeholder pieces' animal art
Modify occupied_cells, anchors, gameplay code, engine, project contracts or manifest
Claim G1/G2/G3/G4 PASS without real tests and HUMAN approval
Build another general art pipeline, extra CI or broad automated image tooling
Auto-trigger DEV implementation or assume cross-chat autonomous synchronization
acceptance: At least one visible panda candidate with recognisable species and user-requested cute/abstract stylisation
Honest comparison against six-cell footprint, including 3 unoccupied bounding cells
No exact asset accepted without HUMAN visual approval; if not approved next step is ART revise or report BLOCKED
No true binary delivery PASS without original PNG bytes readback + independent SHA256 verification by recipient DEV
No formal new game levels or art batch frozen by this probe
next_owner_after_art: HUMAN visual acceptance via ART; then DESIGN may issue separate one-owner DEV integration task for selected exact asset version
notes: User explicitly rejected prior giraffe silhouette and requested panda 123457. Use playful interpretation, do not repeat strict natural species-shape assumptions.
